usedFor: Membership events in Memberful, like “When a new subscription is created”, hold a workflow through “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscription is created” in Memberful, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A new subscription starts a wait, since the action pauses the workflow for X minutes before later steps run.

watchOut: “When a subscription is updated” fires on any update, so each one pauses the workflow for your “Pause Workflow” minutes.
